title: Florida HB 1181 (2025) - Motor Vehicle Insurance, bill history
claims: Florida HB 1181 (2025) was titled Motor Vehicle Insurance and would have repealed provisions relating to application of the Florida Motor Vehicle No-Fault Law and revised motor vehicle insurance coverages, with a proposed effective date of July 1, 2026.
HB 1181 (2025) was indefinitely postponed and withdrawn from consideration on May 3, 2025 and died in the Judiciary Committee on June 16, 2025.
updateCadence: Bill-specific; check each Florida session for enacted changes.
statusNote: HB 1181 (2025) did not become law. It was indefinitely postponed in the House Judiciary Committee on May 3, 2025, and the bill history records the last action as "6/16/2025 House - Died in Judiciary Committee". Cited for legislative history only. A reader who sees this bill cited and assumes Florida no-fault has been repealed has been misled.
